parts.covers: Shows the only recorded shelf observations (11:00 audits on Tuesdays and Fridays) for ATTA-WW-5KG up to 12 June. There is no audit on 10, 11 or 12 June, so the premise that the shelf was empty on those days is not recorded.

parts.plan_in_words: From shelf-audit row records; keep rows where shelf audits.sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' and shelf audits.audit_ts >= '2026-06-01' and shelf audits.audit_ts <= '2026-06-12'; report audit_ts = shelf audits.audit_ts, status = shelf audits.status; sorted by audit_ts asc.

parts.sql: select count(*) as "shipment_count" from "shipments-june"  where (substr(substr("shipments-june"."arrived_ts",1,10),1,10) between ? and ?) limit 1
parts.plan_in_words: From shipment records; keep rows where day(shipments.arrived_ts) between 2026-06-01 and 2026-06-30; report shipment_count = count of *.

parts.covers: Vehicle (driver) with the maximum positive delay in hours (arrived after slot_end) among June 2026 arrivals, using the ontology definition of on-time arrival.
parts.sql: select "shipments-june"."vehicle" as "vehicle", max((24.0 * (julianday("shipments-june"."arrived_ts") - julianday("shipments-june"."slot_end")))) as "max_delay_hours" from "shipments-june"  where (substr(substr("shipments-june"."arrived_ts",1,10),1,10) between ? and ?) and ("shipments-june"."arrived_ts" is not null) and ("shipments-june"."slot_end" is not null) group by "shipments-june"."vehicle" having ("max_delay_hours" > ?) order by "max_delay_hours" desc limit 1
parts.plan_in_words: From shipment records; keep rows where day(shipments.arrived_ts) between 2026-06-01 and 2026-06-30 and shipments.arrived_ts is not empty and shipments.slot_end is not empty; group by shipments.vehicle; keep groups where max_delay_hours > 0; report vehicle = shipments.vehicle, max_delay_hours = max of hours_between(shipments.slot_end, shipments.arrived_ts); sorted by max_delay_hours desc.
